readerIntegration: Do not register or call this module from the PDF reader until issue #45 provides a text-item adapter and issue #27 provides the reviewed corpus. Keep the API private.

textItem.transform: [a, b, c, d, e, f] PDF user-space matrix in PDF.js convention
textItem.dir: ltr or rtl; unsupported directions such as ttb are skipped until an adapter resolves/splits vertical text

page.width: unrotated media-box width in page user units
page.height: unrotated media-box height in page user units

inputContract.outlinePresent: Suppress font-size heading guesses when outline headings are supplied.

heuristics.columns: Up to three start-position clusters with at least two lines each
heuristics.footnotes: Lines in the bottom 10% of the rotated page follow main content
heuristics.paragraphBreaks: Scale line spacing and indentation to font size; punctuation increases sensitivity to larger inter-line gaps
heuristics.dehyphenation: Drop trailing hyphen only before lowercase ASCII a-z
heuristics.outputBudget: Check staged text with Budget.checkOutputChars before retaining it; keep a safe prefix if truncation is allowed; do not charge because DocBuilder owns final output accounting
heuristics.lineSourceIndices: Retain contributing source indices in reading order; sourceIndex is the lowest contributing index
heuristics.unsupportedDirections: Count skipped unsupportedDirectionItems; adapter must staticwarn or resolve/split these items.

validation: Synthetic unit tests only. End-to-end accuracy, real-page goldens, and adapter compatibility remain unverified until #45/#27.
